summary: Verified widget footer 'Powered by Consenso+' link bug fix. Widget served at /api/widget/{tenant_id}?agent={agent_id} correctly renders footer with a single <a> wrapping all text, href='https://consenso-plus.com/', target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer', aria-label='Powered by Consenso+'. Clicking the link opens a new tab pointing to https://consenso-plus.com/ (Playwright context 'page' event fired with correct URL). Cursor is 'pointer'. 'Consenso+' preserves brand color (rgb(0,105,254)) via .brand span; 'Powered by' remains gray via .footer color:#9AA4B6. No stray text outside the <a>. Design/alignment preserved (screenshot confirms).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Widget footer fix verified: href, target, rel, aria-label all correct. New tab event fires opening consenso-plus.com. Brand color and gray color preserved. Full text wrapped in single <a>. No leftover href='#'.
rca of the issue: Original bug had href='#' preventing navigation; fix replaced with proper anchor attributes and wrapped full text (including brand span) inside the <a> so clicks anywhere on the footer text navigate correctly.
